privileged_info_for_vlm: The four items are real historical works: 1. John Forbes Nash Jr.'s 1950 PhD dissertation 'Non-Cooperative Games' at Princeton (32 pages). 2. US Patent US4405829A for RSA encryption (1983-09-20) by Rivest, Shamir, and Adleman. 3. BBN Report 4799 (1981-04-01) regarding ARPANET history. 4. Alan Turing's 'Computing Machinery and Intelligence' as a section in 'The World of Mathematics' (1956), Vol 4, pages 2099-2123, edited by James R. Newman.
